description: Read one document as Folio's model holds it: its blocks with their ids, the blocks its page shows once includes are expanded, its declared kind and fields, and the data files it reads. Call it for the block ids that folio_provenance and folio_history take and that a link to a block names - an id is 8 hex characters Folio derives, never invented - and to see what a page is made of; read the file itself for its full text. Answers {path, kind: markdown or mermaid, blocks: [{id, kind, lines: [first, last] from 1, text: its first 100 characters}], page: [{id, kind, source: the file the block comes from, lines, at: its lines in the expanded page, version}], conventions: {declarations, kind, declaredIn, fields}, data: [paths]}. A document Folio has not read yet is an error: ask again shortly. A list cut to fit one answer adds omitted, the entries each list left out, and narrow, how to ask for less.

path.description: The document's path, relative to the served folder or absolute under it, such as notes/plan.md

name: folio_document
title: Read a document's blocks
